ov: الإفطار عند تيفاني (الإنجليزية: Breakfast at Tiffany's) هو فيلم موسيقي تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1961. ومن إخراج بليك إدواردز
plotEn:
Fending off a date from the night before, Holly Golightly pauses at the window of the Tiffany & Co. flagship store on her way home; her date finds her at her apartment building. He demands that the $50 he gave her "for the powder room" entitles him to her favors. When her neighbor, Mr. Yunioshi, appears to complain that she abuses buzzing his doorbell to be let in, Holly escapes her unwanted escort. Later, new neighbor Paul Varjak buzzes Holly to gain entrance to the building and asks to use her telephone. After using her phone, Paul takes in Holly's unconventional décor (her sofa is half a claw-foot bathtub) and lifestyle. Holly suddenly remembers it's Thursday and she must leave for her weekly visit to incarcerated mobster Sally Tomato. Tomato's lawyer pays her $100 a week to deliver "the weather report". A taxi arrives with Paul's "decorator" Emily Eustace Failenson, a wealthy older woman, whom Paul nicknames "2E"; Paul introduces them as Holly departs in the taxi. That night, when Holly crawls out onto the fire escape to elude another overeager date, she peers through the window and sees Paul in bed and 2E leaving him money and kissing him goodbye.
Climbing in the window, Holly chats with Paul and learns he is a writer who has not had anything published in five years. Holly explains she is saving money to support her brother, Fred, after he completes his Army service. Tired, Holly climbs into bed with Paul, asserting that they are just friends.
